title: Automatic Fairness Testing of Neural Classifiers through Adversarial Sampling
findings: The proposed method, ADF, effectively identified a high number of discriminatory samples related to religious terms in toxicity classification tasks. Retraining the models with these generated samples significantly reduced the model's discrimination, improving fairness by an average of 60.2% on text datasets, which included religion as a protected attribute.
